note: Woodbury County Conservation Board, Loess Hills south-west of Smithland; the camp lies about a mile in from the entrance. Two stocked ponds, trails, 3D archery, equestrian trails; general RV camping, not horse-only. --Claude
summary: Changed booking FCFS-only -> reservable online on MyCountyParks (county notice effective 2026-07-15), fcfs cleared. Count 31->30 (19 electric + 10 tent + 1 backcountry). Added $25 base, $17 non-electric, water, potable, 14-day limit. Confirmed 50-amp, showers, dump, season. Pin ~1 km off.
flags: PIN: stored 42.22901,-95.94782 is Google's point at the park entrance on 330th St. The county's map puts modern camping ~1 km SW; imagery shows the two pad rows at about 42.2204,-95.9533 and 42.2216,-95.9519. Proposed centre 42.2210,-95.9526. Pads are visible.

Booking conflict: MyCountyParks' own park text still says 'Campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis and feature self-registration'; the county's site says all reservations and payments must be online since July 15, 2026, and the engine lists every site. I took the county's dated notice. The 'More information here' link stayed unread (no plain-HTML target).
Waterfront: 'not waterfront' stands. The two ponds (~1 ha) are 400+ m south of the pads, and under 5 acres, so ponds, no view value.
